label: prf:skein-mass-relation
title: Proof of $q$-Deformed Skein Relation
html:
We identify the electron with the trefoil 3_1. This torus knot has \mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta_{3_1}) = 0 in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}] (algebraic quantum volume). It sits at the base of the topological tower, providing the unit against which we measure all other masses. We identify the Higgs field with the figure-eight knot 4_1 (cohomological embedding). Its algebraic quantum volume \mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta_{4_1}) τ-realises to the hyperbolic-volume constant \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) \approx 2.02988.

Applying the algebraic topological mass formula (algebraic topological mass) to the muon–electron ratio eliminates the overall mass scale. This gives m_\mu / m_e = \Phi_1(4_1) / \hbar_q^{2} at the \mathbb{Q}(q) level. Here, \Phi_1(4_1) = \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(\mathrm{Vol}_q(4_1)) is the \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}-image of the algebraic quantum volume (def:algebraic-quantum-volume). Under \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}, the value \Phi_1(4_1) specialises to the numerical hyperbolic volume \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) via the volume conjecture [kashaev1997, murakami-murakami2001]. This constitutes τ-side naming of the algebraic value, not a derivation input. Substituting \hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} and the CODATA value m_\mu / m_e \approx 206.7682827(46) yields

  \hbar_q^{2}
  = \frac{\mathrm{Vol}(4_1)}{m_\mu / m_e}
  = \frac{2.02988}{206.7683}
  \approx 0.009817,
  \qquad
  \hbar_q \approx 0.09908,

so 1/q = 1 - 0.09908 = 0.9009 and q \approx 1.10998.

The Skein relation acts as the mass-functional analogue of the Kauffman bracket recursion. At each crossing in the color-exchange diagram of a hadron, the three resolutions L_+, L_-, and L_0 satisfy q\mathcal{M}(L_+) - q^{-1}\mathcal{M}(L_-) = (q^{1/2}-q^{-1/2})\mathcal{M}(L_0). This relation descends from the q-deformed \mathrm{SU}(2) Chern--Simons functional on the 1-jet bundle prolongation of the CR manifold (Chapter). \square
